general.q: Which country has the longest total coastline in the world?
general.why: Canada boasts over 202,000 km of coastline, far more than any other nation.

general.q: Which metal has the chemical symbol Pb on the periodic table?
general.why: The symbol Pb comes from plumbum, the Latin word for lead.

general.q: What is the traditional collective noun for a group of owls?
general.why: While crows form a murder and eagles a convocation, owls gather in a parliament.

general.q: In which year did the Channel Tunnel officially open to passenger services?
general.why: Queen Elizabeth II and President François Mitterrand opened the tunnel in May 1994.

general.q: Which letter does not appear in the name of any US state?
general.why: Every letter of the alphabet appears at least once in a US state name except Q.

pop.q: In the BBC comedy Gavin & Stacey, what type of trip is the source of Uncle Bryn and Jason's secret incident?
pop.why: Details of what happened on Bryn and Jason's fishing trip remain one of British TV's greatest unsolved mysteries.

pop.q: What is the name of the fictional language spoken by characters throughout The Sims video game franchise?
pop.why: Simlish was created using spoken gibberish so developers didn't need to translate dialogue into real languages.

pop.q: Which soft drink brand was famously advertised in the UK with the catchphrase 'What's the worst that could happen?'?
pop.why: The slogan featured in comical UK adverts showing embarrassing scenarios unfolding after taking a sip.

pop.q: Which UK toy company originally created and manufactured Polly Pocket before selling the brand to Mattel?
pop.why: Bluebird Toys launched Polly Pocket in 1989 after it was created inside a makeup powder compact.

pop.q: In the hit 1997 British comedy film The Full Monty, in which Yorkshire city do the unemployed steelworkers live?
pop.why: The film follows six unemployed former steelworkers in Sheffield who decide to form a male striptease act.

music.q: Which British band released the hit 1997 album 'Urban Hymns'?
music.why: The Verve's 'Urban Hymns' topped the UK charts for 12 weeks and featured 'Bitter Sweet Symphony'.

music.q: Which Frankie Goes to Hollywood single hit UK Number 1 in 1984 after being banned by the BBC?
music.why: BBC Radio 1 DJ Mike Read refused to play 'Relax', which helped propel it to Number 1 for five weeks.

music.q: Which Fatboy Slim music video famously featured actor Christopher Walken dancing in a hotel?
music.why: Christopher Walken, a trained dancer, starred in the iconic 2001 video directed by Spike Jonze.

music.q: Which singer finished in second place for the UK at the 2022 Eurovision Song Contest with 'Space Man'?
music.why: Sam Ryder won the jury vote and came second behind Ukraine's Kalush Orchestra in Turin.

music.q: Who joined the Sugababes in 2005 as a replacement for departing founding member Mutya Buena?
music.why: Amelle Berrabah joined Keisha Buchanan and Heidi Range, completing the group's second official lineup.

mix.q: Which British band had a UK number one single in 1996 with 'Spaceman'?
mix.why: Levi's featured the track in a TV advert, propelling the band straight to number one.

mix.q: Which sea separates Great Britain from the island of Ireland?
mix.why: The Irish Sea connects to the Atlantic via the North Channel and St George's Channel.

mix.q: What is the main structural protein found in human hair and nails?
mix.why: Keratin is a tough protein that also forms the protective outer layer of human skin.

mix.q: Which 1980 single by The Jam went straight to number one on the UK charts?
mix.why: Going Underground was one of the first singles to debut directly at number one in the UK.

mix.q: Which monarch had the shortest reign in English history, lasting nine days in 1553?
mix.why: Lady Jane Grey was deposed by Mary I after just nine days on the throne.

mix.q: Who had a UK number one hit single in 2007 with the pop track 'Umbrella'?
mix.why: Umbrella featuring Jay-Z spent ten consecutive weeks at number one on the UK Singles Chart.

mix.q: In Nintendo's Mario video games, what is the name of Mario's green dinosaur companion?
mix.why: Yoshi made his debut in the 1990 Super Nintendo game Super Mario World.

mix.q: Which spirit is traditionally mixed with dry vermouth and an olive to make a classic Martini?
mix.why: A classic Martini is made with gin and dry vermouth, although vodka is a popular alternative.

mix.q: Which Scottish indie band released the acclaimed 1991 album 'Bandwagonesque'?
mix.why: Bandwagonesque famously beat Nirvana's Nevermind to be named Album of the Year by Spin.

mix.q: Who directed the iconic 1982 sci-fi film E.T. the Extra-Terrestrial?
mix.why: Steven Spielberg created one of cinema's biggest blockbusters about a stranded alien.
